definitions.gloss: prestigious school; elite school; distinguished institution
definitions.explanation: A school with a long history, strong reputation, and notable achievements, whether in academics, sports, or other areas. Applies to schools at all levels from elementary through university.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{名門校|めいもんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れたい→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I want to get my son into a prestigious school.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{名門校|めいもんこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{東大|とうだい}→東大：28577_toudai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{合格者|ごうかくしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: That prestigious school produces many successful Tokyo University applicants every year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{甲子園|こうしえん}→甲子園：23102_koushien⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名門校|めいもんこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Elite schools from across the country gather at Koshien.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{名門|めいもん}→名門：11955_meimon⟧ (distinguished family/lineage; prestigious institution) + {校|こう} (school). Refers to schools renowned for their tradition, academic excellence, or competitive success in sports.

In Japan, {名門校|めいもんこう} can refer to academic powerhouses (schools that send many students to top universities), or to schools famous for sports achievements (especially in baseball at ⟦{甲子園|こうしえん}→甲子園：23102_koushien⟧ or in ⟦{駅伝|えきでん}→駅伝：30715_ekiden⟧ relay racing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名門校|めいもんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to attend a prestigious school
- {名門校|めいもんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧: graduate of a prestigious school
- {名門校|めいもんこう}⟦{同士|どうし}→同士：03474_doushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対戦|たいせん}→対戦：15338_taisen⟧: a match between elite schools
- ⟦{私立|しりつ}→私立：00370_shiritsu⟧{名門校|めいもんこう}: private prestigious school
- ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名門校|めいもんこう}: local elite school

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{名門|めいもん}→名門：11955_meimon⟧: prestigious institution — the base word, also used for families and organizations
- ⟦{進学校|しんがくこう}→進学校：17212_shingakukou⟧: college-prep school — specifically focused on academic achievement and university entrance
- {有名校|ゆうめいこう}: famous school — simply well-known, without the prestige connotation
